submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 at 37 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.225% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate, significantly outperforming Algorithm-L3 (84.984% at 35 GeV) and Algorithm-L1 (74.047% at 30 GeV). The simulation tested thresholds from 20-60 GeV across all three candidate algorithms, confirming that Algorithm-L2 at 37 GeV provides optimal performance. The iterative topological clustering with learned calibration provides superior signal identification compared to simpler approaches. All candidate algorithms are stated to fit within the FPGA resource budget, and Algorithm-L2's inclusion as a candidate implies it meets the latency requirements. This recommendation maximizes signal efficiency while operating within all stated constraints.
